description: Add distinct liveness and readiness probes with a sane initialDelaySeconds, so the app isn't killed before it has finished starting
prompts: k8s/deployment.yaml's search-api Deployment has no probes at all - Kubernetes can send traffic to a pod before it's ready and won't restart one that's wedged. Add BOTH a readinessProbe and a livenessProbe on the container: readinessProbe hits GET /ready on port 8080 with initialDelaySeconds 5 and periodSeconds 5; livenessProbe hits GET /healthz on port 8080 with initialDelaySeconds 30 (must be noticeably longer than readiness's, since the app takes up to ~20s to finish warming caches on boot - a liveness probe that fires before that will kill and restart the pod in a crash loop before it ever becomes ready) and periodSeconds 10. Use two DIFFERENT paths (/ready vs /healthz), not the same handler for both.

setup_files.k8s/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: search-api
  namespace: default
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: search-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: search-api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: search-api
          image: ghcr.io/example/search-api:5.2.0
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080

test_setup_files.check_probes.py:
import yaml

with open("k8s/deployment.yaml") as f:
    dep = yaml.safe_load(f)

container = dep["spec"]["template"]["spec"]["containers"][0]
readiness = container.get("readinessProbe")
liveness = container.get("livenessProbe")
assert readiness, "readinessProbe missing"
assert liveness, "livenessProbe missing"

r_path = readiness["httpGet"]["path"]
l_path = liveness["httpGet"]["path"]
assert r_path != l_path, "readiness and liveness must use different paths, not the same handler"
assert r_path == "/ready", f"expected readiness path /ready, got {r_path}"
assert l_path == "/healthz", f"expected liveness path /healthz, got {l_path}"

l_delay = liveness.get("initialDelaySeconds", 0)
r_delay = readiness.get("initialDelaySeconds", 0)
assert l_delay >= 30, (
    f"livenessProbe.initialDelaySeconds is {l_delay} - too short for a ~20s warmup, "
    f"the pod will be killed before it's ready")
assert l_delay > r_delay, "liveness must start checking noticeably later than readiness"

print("PASS probe checks")

reference_solution.k8s/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: search-api
  namespace: default
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: search-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: search-api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: search-api
          image: ghcr.io/example/search-api:5.2.0
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /ready
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
